name: jarvis-pi-nettools-ui-tests
description: Mock Pi API + Playwright suites for app/static (run against the mock, nothing touches a real Pi)

scripts.test: for t in e2e e2e-inline e2e-live e2e-live2 e2e-speed e2e-home e2e-usb e2e-power e2e-hotspot e2e-history e2e-wizard e2e-battery e2e-finish e2e-share e2e-scan e2e-tools e2e-lan e2e-pages e2e-toolopts e2e-pages2; do echo "== $t"; node tests/$t.mjs || exit 1; done
